outputs: natural language responses based on dialogue acts and database records

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate Token-MoE variant and simplified output descriptions. Token-MoE and Token-MoE refer to the same model.
Removed duplicate 'combined score' (lowercase variant) since 'Combined Score' is already listed.
No LLM-based evaluation was used in this paper (published in 2020 before LLM-as-judge became common).

guideline: Judges rank response pairs based on completion (relevance and informativeness) and readability (fluency, naturalness, consistency)

changes_made.explanation: Added missing human evaluation methodology details mentioned in the paper: three judges per pair and random assignment.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Paper focuses on task-oriented dialogue generation with co-generation of dialogue acts and responses. Human evaluation was well-documented with clear criteria. No LLM-based evaluation was used (paper predates that trend). Automatic metrics were correctly identified, though some normalization was needed for duplicates.
